convention: centre in the quadrant [0,s/2]^2 (grid of step h anchored at 0, the last column/row may stick out past s/2), tilt theta in [0,45] deg; the D4 action is r:(x,y)->(s-y,x) with theta fixed (theta is mod 90) and m:(x,y)->(y,x) with theta->90-theta.  Quadrant x theta<=45 is a fundamental domain (4 x 2 = |D4| = 8).  cx/cy are the ADMISSIBLE CLIP of the grid cell: [max(lo, wLo/2), min(hi, s-wLo/2)] with wLo = min over the t-box of cos+sin -- every admissible placement of the grid cell is in it.
meaning: dead_lb is a certified lower bound on the total area of the listed regions, each of which is (i) interior-disjoint from every placement allowed by the cell, (ii) pairwise interior-disjoint, and (iii) DEAD for that placement -- no unit square inside [0,s]^2 avoiding it can meet the region -- UNIFORMLY over the whole cell box (A23 PlacedBox semantics).  Budget lemma: sum over squares of dead_lb <= s^2 - n for any n-packing meeting the hypothesis, provided the region lists of different squares are pairwise interior-disjoint.
